title: Figure 1: "The UFO Pattern: A Condensed Statement of Repeated Observations" shape chart
description: Chart of line illustrations titled "THE UFO PATTERN - A Condensed Statement of Repeated Observations - Configurations of Highly Repeating Shapes," depicting the saucer (domed, lenticular and lenticular with dome), flat-topped straw hat, double hat, conical hat (giant), sphere, saturn, ellipsoidal (egg or football, hovering and underway), cylindrical (giant cigar), dirigible (large, with luminous plume) and triangle or boomerang (delta, equilateral) forms. A note explains shine marks show typical nighttime air glow and dash-dot lines mark the axis of symmetry. It appears in section "3. Types of UAPs Observed" of the "Summary Report on BAASS UAP Analysis Capabilities," November 23, 2010, page 21.
